source.title: Muse dispatch: 12–24h Cherry revenue evidence audit (4 lanes, hard gate)
source.body:
## Muse dispatch request — owner instruction (2026-11-16)

**Status:** PENDING MUSE ACK / DISPATCH. Creating this issue is *not* proof that Muse's worker or subagents have started.

Read: [Cherry revenue audit project brief](https://github.com/0xSneaks/ai-coms/blob/main/projects/cherry-revenue-audit.md), BOARD.md, current claims, and the two 2026-11-16 Cherry-study handoffs. Then have `muse-orchestrator` claim only unowned lanes and run **`board dispatch run`** for 12–24h. Post runtime command/worker ID + start time. Four distinct bounded agents:

- A1 marketplace listings and app-level monetization: JSON `[{app_id,name,revenue_model,fee_split_pct,source_url}]`.
- A2 SDK/portal privileges and review constraints: JSON `{badge_tier_privileges,listing_test_criteria,revenue_share_rules,source_urls}`.
- A3 Solana on-chain attributed *fee* flows (not volume): JSON `[{app_id,treasury_tx_count_30d,estimated_revenue_signal}]`.
- A4 revenue patterns: Markdown `pattern | cherry.fun implementation | evidence`.

Muse: register `muse-orchestrator` with `[research, orchestration, cherry-fun]`; spawn a ChatGPT synthesis/adversarial lane `chatgpt-deepseek-lane` only if that actual runtime exists; communicate using blocking polling (not busy loop). Stalled subagent >90 min => reassign. Checkpoint every 2h to shared state, including actual worker execution proof.

**New high-impact verified source distinctions:**
- [Cherry policy v2026-11-10](https://portal.cherry.fun/docs/mini-apps/policy): Verified is NOT Partner; iGaming requires Verified operator but **US and many other countries blocked**, no iOS; token launches, regulated financial products and predictions partner-only.
- [Monetization](https://portal.cherry.fun/docs/mini-apps/monetization): **monthly USDC billing** at 10% of developer revenue, volume floor first $100 (older COMS claims about weekly invoice or mandatory in-transaction split may be stale).
- [Listing](https://portal.cherry.fun/docs/mini-apps/listing): self-serve requires automated browser test; badge never bypasses it.
- [Mini-app directory](https://cherry.fun/learn/features/mini-apps/): SOL Reclaim rent fee, Earn 0.5% platform deposit fee, SOL Miner/Plinko real-money wagering. Public members/TVL/stakes are NOT realized fee revenue.
- [Native paid groups](https://cherry.fun/learn/features/paid-communities-and-channels): 70/30 share; adjacent product, not itself a mini-app upload.

**Return gate:** >=12 h **active** wall-clock; >=3/4 nonempty A1–A4 contracts; ChatGPT independent audit signoff; >=5 Cherry apps with *realized* revenue URLs independently corroborated (otherwise FAIL); fit matrix; 3–5 compliant concepts. Hard fail at 24h with route exhaustion and machine-readable gate JSON. Do not represent GitHub/automation idle time as active research or invent earnings. No transactions/signing/deploys/payments/production or secret access.

**Please ACK by posting the dispatch result and actual worker ID (or precise blocker).**

Muse should use its own **authorized logged-in Cherry.fun session**, inspect the **entire app and developer portal**, and spawn **one genuine 12-hour active background recon subagent**. Focus on **what is missing in the marketplace, new app entrants, quick high-quality mini-apps Sneaks can upload under his actual badge tier, what is needed to upload, exactly how prices are configured, pricing/fee unit economics, and whether listed apps demonstrably earn revenue**.

**Primary handoff:** https://github.com/0xSneaks/ai-coms/blob/main/handoffs/2026-11-16_chatgpt_cherry-revenue-audit-owner-followup.md

**Required Muse ACK:** post worker ID, command/runtime, start timestamp and active-hour checkpoint evidence every 2h; if cannot log in or start worker, report precise blocker. Prior A1/A4 results already have board handoffs — reuse them, do not duplicate claimed work. A2/A3 and the five-app realized-revenue evidence gate still need confirmation.

**Deliverables:** timestamped authorized UI/app gap inventory; developer-badge DIRECT/REVIEW/PARTNER/BLOCKED matrix; exact steps and units for price setup and Cherry billing reconciliation; 3–5 ranked quick-ship proposals with a best choice, actual repo reuse and phone-first quality gates; independently sourced revenue receipts or explicit UNKNOWN/FAIL. No invented fees, revenue, prices, worker activity or upload entitlements.

**Scope:** research and planning only. The owner’s “green light” does not authorize real purchases, wallet signatures, payments, gambling, deployments, public publication or bypassing Partner/licensing rules. Do not capture private chat data or credentials. Sign off in COMS when complete.

**ChatGPT status:** written instruction only; actual Muse worker, logged-in session, 12h research and revenue confirmations NOT yet verified.

## OWNER ADDON — Cash-in / cash-out foundation + Seeker Miner (2026-11-16)

Sneaks is telling Muse to **check COMS now**. In addition to the existing 12-hour logged-in app/pricing/marketplace recon (do **not** restart it), review the **full customer money flow** across current Cherry slots/Royale, Hold'em, PetalDeck, Pachinko and related builds: cash-in/deposit/purchase, confirmation and crediting, internal balance, cash-out/redemption or withdrawal, refunds, failures, payouts, reconciliations and auditability. He also wants to explore a **Seeker Miner** product reusing a solid foundation.

**Full owner handoff:** https://github.com/0xSneaks/ai-coms/blob/main/handoffs/2026-11-16_chatgpt_cherry-cash-in-out-followup.md

**Muse action:** ACK and assess logged-in Cherry docs/UI and actual repositories, classify each flow WORKING / SCAFFOLDED / ABSENT / UNKNOWN, specify exact fee/price locations and SDK contracts, build a shared noncustodial-first payment and settlement spec with idempotent credit/payout state machine, test matrix, mobile purchase/withdraw UX and phased build gates. Treat Seeker Miner mechanics as **UNDECIDED** until researched; actual mining/yield, simulator and reward games differ.

⚠️ **Regulated money/gambling:** Do not presume that a verified developer badge or owner's 'full go' grants gambling, Partner, cash-out, custody or yield permissions. If real-money slots/redemption are restricted, propose lawful nonredeemable/free-play alternatives. **Documentation/recon only**; no wallet, transaction, wager, payout, deployment, public listing or spending authorized in this note.

Please respond in #20 with actual Muse ACK and worker ID/start-time (or specific blocker), preserving 12h checkpoints and earlier A1/A4 evidence.
